summary: Iteration 3 (Client Inbox + Follow-Up Copilot flagship) — FULL PASS. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests green in 43s against public URL, plus a separate direct-DB emergency-keyword injection test (1/1) verifying the deterministic safety net. Frontend: end-to-end UI flow — signup → 3-step onboarding → /app dashboard → inbox → tasks → care-gaps — all critical selectors and data-testids resolve and interactions work. Highlights: (1) /api/stats returns open_tasks + urgent_tasks scoped to clinic; (2) fresh signup gets exactly 3 seeded tasks all clinic-scoped, ?status=open filter returns same 3; (3) POST /tasks creates a manual task and it appears in the list; (4) PATCH /tasks/{id} with status=completed sets completed_at; (5) IDEMPOTENCY VERIFIED — fresh signup has 3 tasks → first /tasks/auto-generate creates 8 additional tasks (post-op call for Ollie + chronic monitoring for Milo + stale-message tasks for the 4 seeded messages, minus the seeded ones that share source_ids) → second /tasks/auto-generate creates 0; (6) /care-gaps returns 4 patient groups each with gaps; (7) /messages/{id}/draft returns category field, sets status=drafted, stores category on the message; (8) EMERGENCY-KEYWORD SAFETY NET verified live: injected a message body 'Bella suddenly collapsed and then had a seizure…', drafting it forced category=urgent_review, prefixed internal_note with [EMERGENCY KEYWORD DETECTED: 'collapse'], and created a priority=urgent task tied to source_id=message_id; (9) PATCH /messages/{id}/status accepts valid, rejects invalid with 400; (10) POST /messages/{id}/approve on a refill_request seed message sets status=sent AND creates a follow-up task (task count +1 verified); (11) Multi-tenant isolation confirmed: two accounts see fully disjoint tasks/care-gaps/messages. Frontend UI: landing H1 is exactly 'The clinic copilot that makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.'; /features flagship section has 6 cards (feature-flagship-*) and 'Client Inbox + Follow-Up Copilot' title present; sidebar has nav-inbox, nav-tasks, nav-care-gaps; /app dashboard has all 4 KPI cards (kpi-messages/tasks/patients/drafts) and clicking kpi-messages routes to /app/inbox; /app/inbox shows 8 filter chips and 4 seeded messages with badges — 'AI classify & draft' produced a draft, 'Approve & send' updated status, all 5 status pipeline buttons present (sent, awaiting_reply, booked, paid, closed); /app/tasks shows 5 task cards after auto-generate (3 seeded + newly generated ones), 'Auto-generate' button worked, 'New task' dialog created a task, complete-checkbox marks task done; /app/care-gaps shows 4 patient gap cards with color-coded chips (alert/monitoring/dental/hwt) and 'Draft outreach' creates a task.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto_generate_tasks uses (source_id, title) as idempotency key — matches seed_data source_id format exactly (postop_{pid}, chronic_{pid}_{prob[:12]}, alert_{pid}_{alert[:12]}), so second run creates 0 as verified.

Emergency-keyword safety net (server.py:169) runs AFTER Claude, unconditionally overriding category+internal_note — good belt-and-suspenders; keyword list covers common veterinary emergencies (collapse, seizure, HBC, bloat, toxins, blocked cat).

message_approve creates follow-up tasks for {refill_request, appointment_needed, lab_follow_up} but NOT for {medication_question, billing_admin, routine, urgent_review} — this is intentional per spec.

care_gaps heuristics are static (annual HWT always flagged for canines regardless of whether a recent HWT visit exists) — acceptable for a demo but should eventually check labs/visits for actual HWT dates.
task auto-generate does an O(patients × problems) scan with per-item DB lookup; fine at demo scale (<20 patients) but should batch-fetch existing task source_ids at scale.
server.py has grown to ~700 lines — approaching the threshold where inbox/tasks/care-gaps should move into their own routers/modules.
No pagination on /tasks or /messages (500-item cap via to_list) — acceptable for MVP.
